input.prompt:
## Objective
Research and cross-reference the exact release date of PostgreSQL 16 and identify the single most significant performance improvement introduced in that version.

## Context
The user needs factual, verifiable data about PostgreSQL 16 for a reference. Project: llmfoundry (AI engineering workspace). Use official PostgreSQL release notes, the PostgreSQL website, major tech publications (e.g., InfoWorld, DZone, or similar dev outlets that covered the release), and any other authoritative primary sources. Cross-reference dates and claims across at least 3 independent sources.

## Output contract
Return ONLY the text in the exact format below. No preamble, no commentary, no "based on my research" filler. Use [VERIFIED] on every factual claim.

### RESULT
- PostgreSQL 16 release date: [VERIFIED date] — [source URL, title, date published]
- Main performance improvement: [VERIFIED description of the #1 performance feature] — [source URL, title, date published]

### SOURCES
- [URL1] — [Title1]
- [URL2] — [Title2]
...

## Boundaries
- Do NOT list more than ONE main performance improvement. Pick the most cited / most impactful one.
- Do NOT include subjective commentary, comparisons with other DBs, or future speculation.
- Do NOT return anything outside the ### RESULT and ### SOURCES blocks.
- Do NOT use parametric memory alone — every claim must be backed by fetched sources.
